articles.title: China’s YMTC Kicks Off IPO Process to Tap Booming Memory Demand
articles.summary: Yangtze Memory Technologies Co. has begun the process for a long-awaited initial public offering, tapping red-hot demand for the chipmakers at the heart of a global AI development boom.

articles.title: Tom Steyer Wants to Save California From Billionaires. But Also Doesn’t Want Them to Leave
articles.summary: The hedge fund billionaire turned gubernatorial candidate wants to tax California’s ultrawealthy, regulate AI, and keep Silicon Valley happy at the same time. Good luck with that.

articles.title: Moonshot AI to Overhaul Structure to Win Nod for Hong Kong IPO
articles.summary: Moonshot AI has informed its investors it will revamp its corporate structure to pave the way for an initial public offering in Hong Kong, aligning with Beijing’s tightened requirements for Chinese companies seeking an overseas debut.

articles.title: Jury Ruling in Musk Lawsuit Favors OpenAI
articles.summary: The ruling appeared to clear a path for OpenAI to file for a much anticipated IPO this year and dent the SpaceX and X owner’s reputation.
articles.author: Esther Shittu

articles.title: Seagate Slips as CEO Says New Factories ‘Take Too Long’
articles.summary: Seagate Technology Holdings shares fell 6.9% Monday in its worst one-day drop in nearly two months after management comments at a JPMorgan conference sparked investor fears that the company won’t be able to keep up with soaring demand for memory chips.

articles.title: Elon Musk Says He Wants to Get SpaceX IPO Underway ‘Pretty Soon’
articles.summary: Elon Musk said he’s back in Texas working on plans for an initial public offering of SpaceX as the rocket and artificial intelligence company gears up for the largest listing of all time.
articles.author: Monica Raymunt

articles.title: Mistral CEO Arthur Mensch warns France against letting Anthropic's Mythos scan military code bases
articles.summary: Mistral CEO Arthur Mensch warns of Europe's growing cybersecurity dependency: France's military code bases should not be scanned by US AI models. Modern AI can orchestrate attacks and suggest exploits, including Mistral's own models. Mensch rules out a sale and says Mistral is aiming for an IPO instead. The article Mistral CEO Arthur Mensch warns France against letting Anthropic's Mythos scan military code bases appeared first on The Decoder.

articles.title: Cerebras CEO Is Worth $3.2 Billion After Year’s Largest IPO
articles.summary: Shares of Cerebras Systems Inc. soared about 68% in Nasdaq trading in New York. It’s the year’s biggest initial public offering and gives the company a market value of roughly $67 billion. Bailey Lipschultz, Bloomberg News Senior Equities Reporter, discusses the initial offering and how the company is differentiating itself from incumbents like Nvidia. (Source: Bloomberg)

articles.title: MiniMed Aims to Be 'Self-Driving Car' of Diabetes Care
articles.summary: Diabetes equipment provider MiniMed is aiming to be the “self-driving car” of insulin pumps, says its CEO, Que Dallara. Hot off the heels of the company’s IPO, Dallara speaks with Caroline Hyde on the sidelines of the Consello Spark Summit. (Source: Bloomberg)

articles.title: Cerebras Pulls Back After IPO Day; Gemini Space Station Rises on $100M Investment | Stock Movers
articles.summary: On this episode of Stock Movers with Alexis Christoforous: - Gemini Space Station (GEMI) is rising after Tyler and Cameron Winklevoss made a $100 million “strategic investment” into the company. CEO Tyler Winklevoss said the investment will help fuel the company's ambition to evolve from a crypto company into a markets company. - Magnum Ice Cream (MICC) shares are jumped as much as 22%, the most since the stock’s December listing, after Reuters reported that private equity firms including Blackstone and Clayton Dubilier & Rice are exploring potential bids for the company. - Cerebras Systems (CBRS) shares pulled back after a huge IPO day yesterday. The shares jumped 68% in its trading debut after raising $5.5 billion in the year’s largest IPO. (Source: Bloomberg)

articles.title: Adtek Files for Hong Kong IPO, Adding to Chinese AI Listings
articles.summary: Shenzhen Adtek Technology Co. has filed for an initial public offering in Hong Kong, adding to a wave of listings by Chinese companies related to data centers and artificial intelligence.

articles.title: Cerebras Goes Public in Year's Biggest IPO | Bloomberg Tech 5/14/2026
